Name: Em's River Wildlife (beaver otter osprey)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Add wild otters, beavers and osprey to the farm to take over the task of fishing
These wild river animals provide daily hardwood and seasonal fish
Their fish catch amount is configurable in case your fish needs are small

Otters and beavers sleep in the barn. The osprey sleep in the coop
Only the beaver eats a small bit of grass, the others rely on their fish for food
Beavers and otters can swim when petted, fed and close to water
To prompt them to swim more regularly, try using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15860]Like A Duck To Water[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/c4cRGBLh/Seasonal-Fish.png[/img]

Beaver spring: carp, bullhead
Beaver summer: rainbow trout, largemouth bass
Beaver fall: salmon
Beaver winter: woodskip, lingcod

Otter spring: catfish, chub
Otter summer: pike, dorado
Otter fall: shad
Otter winter, perch

Osprey spring: smallmouth bass, bream
Osprey summer: sunfish, sturgeon
Osprey fall: walleye, midnight carp
Osprey winter: tiger trout

Additionally, the otter and beaver drop hardwood on a more regular basis
When you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]extra animal configs﻿[/url] installed, the quality of hardwood is removed
This is optional and not a requirement, but keeps a tidy barn

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's River Wildlife CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

The default fish catch amount is set to 1 fish a day. To adjust this:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the mod folder
Replace "1" with "2", "3", "5" or "7"
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
This also affects the hardwood amount. Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

1 = 1 fish a day
2 = 1 fish every 2 days
3 = 1 fish every 3 days
5 = 1 fish every 5 days
7 = 1 fish every 7 days
